from.place: Proof decomposition: geometric factorisation and sheaf-theoretic acyclicity from the factorisation.

title: Clopen geometric factorisation of a commutative proper/open square
statement: Let p : B → D and r : C → E be proper morphisms of schemes, and let k : C → B and i : E → D be quasi-compact open immersions with k ≫ p = r ≫ i. Then there exists a scheme V and maps b : V → B, s : V → E, and t : C → V such that b ≫ p = s ≫ i, t ≫ b = k, and t ≫ s = r; b and t are open immersions, s is proper, and t is a closed immersion.

source.place: Tag 0F7B, case (b), with Tags 01W4 and 01W6 for proper immersions and clopen factorisation.

proof.text: Take V = B ×_D E with projections b and s, and let t : C ⟶ V be the pullback lift of k and r. The pullback equations give the commutative square and the equations t ≫ b = k and t ≫ s = r. The existing strict-tower proper/open lift theorem gives that t is both an open and a closed immersion. Base change of the proper morphism p gives that s is proper, while base change of the open immersion i gives that b is an open immersion. Package these maps and properties into the witness.
